headline: Greaves Electric Mobility opens 50 new experience centers
hook: Ampere doubles retail footprint across India
summary: Greaves Cotton subsidiary, Greaves Electric Mobility, has launched over 50 new experience centers for its Ampere brand. This expansion doubles the company's sales and service network across India within a 12-month period. The move aims to increase market penetration for its electric two-wheeler portfolio. Retail investors should note this as a potential indicator of scaling efforts in the competitive EV segment.
why_it_matters: Network expansion may boost long-term EV sales volume and revenue.
winners_losers: Greaves Cotton gains / Competitors face increased pressure

headline: Ampere launches Nexus EX+ electric scooter at ₹1.29 lakh
hook: New electric scooter targets mass market segment
summary: Greaves Electric Mobility has launched the Ampere Nexus EX+ electric scooter priced at ₹1.29 lakh. The vehicle features a 5kW motor, a claimed range of 136 km, and a battery life rated for 2 lakh kilometers. It includes over 30 connected features and offers faster charging capabilities. This launch expands the company's portfolio in the competitive Indian electric two-wheeler market.
why_it_matters: Increased competition in the electric two-wheeler space benefits consumers.
winners_losers: Greaves Cotton gains / incumbent EV makers face competition

headline: Greaves Electric Mobility expands its EV portfolio with the Ampere Nexus EX+ launch
summary: Greaves Cotton announced that its subsidiary, Greaves Electric Mobility, has launched the Ampere Nexus EX+ electric scooter. The new model features an IoT-enabled Intellipack to strengthen its existing Nexus EV lineup. This product expansion aims to capture a larger share of the competitive Indian two-wheeler electric vehicle market. Retail investors in Greaves Cotton can track how this new variant impacts the subsidiary's sales volume and adoption rates.
whats_next: Quarterly sales figures for electric mobility segment
why_it_matters: New EV model launch could boost subsidiary revenue for Greaves Cotton.
winners_losers: Greaves Electric gains / rival EV makers challenged
